title: Generalized binomial series
statement:
Let $s,x\in\mathbb R$ with $|x|<1$. Then the generalized binomial series converges to $(1+x)^s$:
\[\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{k}x^k=(1+x)^s,\]
where $\binom{s}{k}=s(s-1)\cdots(s-k+1)/k!$ and $\binom{s}{0}=1$.
replaced: Let $s,x\in\bbr$ with $|x|<1$, the generalized binomial series converges and $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{k}x^k=(1+x)^s$, where $\binom{s}{k}=s(s-1)\cdots(s-k+1)/k!$ and $\binom{s}{0}=1$.
